description: Change a SIP trunk: rename it, add an origination address (or remove one by removeOriginationId on Twilio), add or remove numbers (a removed Telnyx number goes back to Hermoso's call handling), on Telnyx set its outbound voice profile, and rotatePassword:true gives the trunk's SIP credentials a new password (password, or a generated one), shown once; rotating changes nothing without confirm:true. Free. Needs Twilio or Telnyx connected (Connectors, or connect_connector).
name: update_sip_trunk
title: Change a SIP trunk
